purpose: Provide a session-bounded ontology of concrete appraisal and scoring work-units for detecting mis/disinformation and computing a calibrated credibility/confidence score for news and claims, as a subdomain node in a knowledge-searcher meta-KB.
assumptions: the parent domain is Geopolitics, News & Information Integrity; this KB covers the misinformation_detection_and_credibility_scoring subdomain only
no observed dataset or benchmark is supplied; all numeric values are heuristic priors
nodes are concrete appraisal/scoring methods, each bounded to one heavy reasoning session
the appraiser has access to the item, its embedded media, and open-web investigation tools
this subdomain composes argumentation (fallacy/appraisal) and source-trust subdomains rather than redefining them
exclusions: discovery and retrieval of the items themselves (covered by sibling retrieval subdomains)
platform content-moderation policy, takedown, and legal adjudication
general argumentation theory and informal-logic fallacy taxonomy (sibling argumentation subdomain)
training of detection models and dataset construction

competency_questions.question: Given a raw item and context, how is it scoped and what credibility scale and threshold apply?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SCOPE_FRAME fixes scope, scale, and threshold

competency_questions.question: How is the item classified across the falseness and intent-to-harm axes into mis/dis/malinformation?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: INFO_DISORDER_TYPE assigns a disorder type with an intent note

competency_questions.question: How are the specific falsifiable claims extracted and separated from opinion and framing?
How is the content's origin, first appearance, and edit history established?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PROVENANCE_TRACE records first-seen and original context

competency_questions.question: How is the publishing source's authority, independence, and track record appraised?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SOURCE_AUTHORITY produces an authority prior with conflicts noted

competency_questions.question: What fast lateral-reading and SIFT moves resolve or escalate an item before deep analysis?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LATERAL_READING and SIFT_TRIAGE produce a who-is-behind-it profile and triage verdict

competency_questions.question: How are recontextualized media and synthetic/manipulated media detected?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REVERSE_IMAGE and DEEPFAKE_DETECT produce recontext and manipulation findings

competency_questions.question: How is independent, non-circular corroboration assessed and weighted?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CORROBORATION builds an independence-adjusted support level

competency_questions.question: How is each claim checked against authoritative primary records and prior fact-checks?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CLAIM_CHECK maps each claim to an authoritative reference

competency_questions.question: How are propaganda techniques and engineered affect identified without conflating them with falsehood?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PROPAGANDA_TECH and EMOTIONAL_MANIP inventory techniques separately from truth

competency_questions.question: How are spread dynamics, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and echo-chamber context analyzed?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SPREAD_DYNAMICS, BOT_TROLL_DETECT, and ECHO_CHAMBER characterize amplification and exposure

competency_questions.question: How is the appraisal itself screened for bias and motivated reasoning?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BIAS_SCREEN forces disconfirmation search before locking

competency_questions.question: How are findings fused into a composite credibility score with calibrated uncertainty?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CREDIBILITY_SCORE and UNCERTAINTY_CALIB produce an auditable score with an interval

competency_questions.question: How is the final verdict assigned, published, and updated as new evidence arrives?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: VERDICT_RATING assigns a traceable rating and MONITOR_UPDATE maintains it

glossary.definition: false or misleading content shared without intent to harm
false content deliberately created or shared to deceive or harm
genuine information weaponized out of context to cause harm
leaving a page to learn from other sources who is behind it and what they say
a triage routine: Stop, Investigate the source, Find better coverage, Trace to original
the documented origin, history, and chain of custody of a piece of content
reusing authentic media with a false time, place, or caption
AI-synthesized or manipulated media depicting events that did not occur as shown
confirmation of a claim by independent, non-circular sources
organized use of fake or deceptive accounts to manipulate spread
a network environment that reinforces a view by limiting cross-cutting exposure
a weighted composite estimate of how trustworthy a claim or item is
matching stated confidence to actual evidence strength and base rates
the ordered set of verdict categories a claim can be assigned

evidence_label_policy.note: No observed/experimental inputs supplied; only heuristic labels are eligible.

source_registry.description: Heuristic priors from established verification, information-disorder, and credibility literature (Silverman ed. Verification Handbook 2014/2020; Wardle & Derakhshan Information Disorder 2017; O'Connor & Weatherall The Misinformation Age 2019; Caulfield SIFT/lateral-reading; Wineburg & McGrew lateral reading studies) and analytic practice; no measured dataset supplied.
grounding_limits: all numeric values are heuristic priors, not measurements
no observed or experimentally_validated labels are eligible

normalization_definitions.rounding: round computed scores to 2 decimals; tolerance 0.02

nodes.definition: Frame the target item and claim and fix the credibility scale, verdict categories, and decision threshold before any investigation begins.
contradictors: actor who states the claim too vaguely to test

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when the item is rescoped, the audience changes, or the verdict scale is revised

pros.claim: every later score is relative to a fixed credibility scale and threshold
pros.example: a 'true/false' scale rejects nuance a 'mostly-true..pants-on-fire' scale captures

cons.claim: a vague item makes corroboration and scoring untestable
cons.example: 'the economy is bad' has no checkable referent to score

failure_modes: item left ambiguous so claims cannot be extracted
scale left implicit and applied inconsistently
acceptance_tests: item is a single scoped artifact with a stated claim focus
credibility scale and threshold are explicit and justified

nodes.definition: Classify the item on the information-disorder axes of falseness and intent to harm into misinformation, disinformation, or malinformation.

excluded: actor attribution to a named entity

contradictors: analyst who conflates honest error with deliberate deception

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when new provenance or intent evidence shifts the falseness/intent classification

pros.claim: separating error from intent steers the right remedy and tone
pros.example: a sincere mistake gets a correction; a coordinated deception gets exposure

cons.claim: intent is rarely directly observable and is easy to over-attribute
cons.example: labeling a careless share as 'disinformation' overstates malice

failure_modes: intent inferred from falseness alone
malinformation (true-but-weaponized) mislabeled as false

nodes.definition: Extract the specific, falsifiable claim or claims embedded in the item and separate them from opinion, framing, and rhetorical packaging.
contradictors: author who buries the claim in implication

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when the item is reread and an unstated but checkable claim is surfaced

pros.claim: only an explicit claim can be corroborated or refuted
pros.example: 'crime is exploding' becomes the checkable 'violent crime rose X% in city Y in year Z'

cons.claim: implied claims may be missed or over-read into the text
cons.example: reading a numeric assertion into a vague headline invents a strawman

failure_modes: opinion treated as a factual claim
compound claim not decomposed into testable parts
revisit_triggers: new claim implied by added context

nodes.definition: Trace the origin, first appearance, and edit/repost history of the content to establish where and when it actually originated.
contradictors: uploader who strips metadata to hide origin

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when an earlier original or a contradicting first-seen timestamp is found

pros.claim: origin context often refutes the recontextualized framing
pros.example: a 2015 photo reshared as 'today' is debunked by its first-seen date

cons.claim: provenance trails can be erased, faked, or laundered through reposts
cons.example: a screenshot of a screenshot hides the deletable original

failure_modes: earliest copy mistaken for the original
fabricated timestamp accepted as authentic

nodes.definition: Assess the authority, expertise, independence, and correction track-record of the publishing source as a prior on reliability.
contradictors: source that buys credibility through branding alone

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when the source's funding, ownership, or correction record changes the reliability prior

pros.claim: a documented correction record is a strong reliability signal
pros.example: an outlet that issues prompt corrections is more trustworthy than one that never does

cons.claim: authority is a prior not a verdict and can be gamed by mimicry
cons.example: a fake site cloning a real outlet's brand inherits unearned authority

failure_modes: brand prestige mistaken for claim-level accuracy
funding conflict ignored

nodes.definition: Leave the page and read across the open web to learn who is behind a source and what others independently say about it.
contradictors: reader who evaluates a site only from its own About page

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when external sources reveal an undisclosed agenda or sponsor behind the page

pros.claim: reading what others say beats trusting a source's self-description
pros.example: searching an outlet's name reveals it is a known astroturf operation

cons.claim: requires open external sources and is weak for obscure local items
cons.example: a tiny local blog may have no external footprint to read laterally

failure_modes: vertical reading only, trusting the page itself
mistaking SEO-boosted self-promotion for reputation

nodes.definition: Apply the SIFT moves (Stop, Investigate the source, Find better coverage, Trace to original) for fast triage before deep analysis.
contradictors: user who shares on impulse without stopping

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when triage clears an item that deeper checks later contradict

pros.claim: cheap moves resolve most items before costly forensics
pros.example: 'find better coverage' instantly confirms a viral claim no reputable outlet reports

cons.claim: speed-optimized triage can miss sophisticated fabrications
cons.example: a well-crafted deepfake passes quick triage and needs forensic analysis

failure_modes: triage treated as a final verdict
stop step skipped under time pressure

nodes.definition: Run reverse-image and clip search to detect recontextualized, miscaptioned, or out-of-date media reused to mislead.
contradictors: editor who recaptions old footage as breaking news

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when an earlier or original use of the media contradicts the current caption

pros.claim: most viral 'photo' hoaxes are real images in a false context
pros.example: a war photo from a prior conflict reshared as the current war

cons.claim: cropped, mirrored, or AI-altered media can evade index matches
cons.example: a flipped and recolored image returns no reverse-search hit

failure_modes: no-hit treated as proof of authenticity
earliest index hit mistaken for true origin

nodes.definition: Detect manipulated or AI-synthesized media (deepfakes, edits, splices) using artifact, physiological, and provenance signals.
contradictors: creator who launders synthetic media through re-encoding

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when a stronger detector, provenance signature, or admission changes the manipulation likelihood

pros.claim: provenance/watermark signals can confirm synthesis when detectors are unsure
pros.example: a C2PA-signed origin or model watermark settles a contested clip

cons.claim: detectors are brittle, beatable, and produce false positives/negatives
cons.example: a re-compressed real video is flagged synthetic by an over-tuned detector

failure_modes: detector output trusted without provenance corroboration
real media falsely flagged as fake (over-call)
acceptance_tests: manipulation claim corroborated by at least two independent signals
detector uncertainty and version recorded
revisit_triggers: new detector or provenance standard available

nodes.definition: Seek independent, non-circular sources that confirm or contradict the claim and weight them by independence and diagnosticity.
contradictors: network that recirculates one origin as many 'sources'

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when an apparent independent source is found to share the original's origin

pros.claim: independent convergence is the strongest non-expert credibility signal
pros.example: three outlets with separate reporting trails confirm a quote

cons.claim: echoed copies masquerade as independent corroboration
cons.example: ten sites citing one wire story are one source, not ten

failure_modes: circular citation counted as independent support
absence of coverage misread as confirmation
revisit_triggers: a 'source' is shown to be circular

nodes.definition: Check each extracted claim against authoritative primary records, datasets, expert consensus, and prior fact-checks.
contradictors: claimant who cites a misread or cherry-picked statistic

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when a primary record or correction overturns the claim's accuracy finding

pros.claim: a primary record settles many claims decisively
pros.example: the official dataset directly contradicts the cited figure

cons.claim: authoritative sources can be stale, contested, or misread
cons.example: relying on a superseded report yields a wrong verdict

failure_modes: secondary summary trusted over the primary record
cherry-picked statistic accepted at face value
acceptance_tests: each claim mapped to at least one authoritative reference
contradicting evidence searched, not just confirming

nodes.definition: Identify persuasion and propaganda techniques (loaded language, false dichotomy, whataboutism, manufactured doubt) operating in the item.
contradictors: communicator who frames manipulation as mere style

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when reanalysis reveals an additional technique or downgrades a misread one

pros.claim: named techniques make manipulation legible and teachable
pros.example: spotting 'manufactured doubt' explains a tobacco-style denial campaign

cons.claim: technique labels do not by themselves prove a claim false
cons.example: a true claim can still be delivered with loaded language

failure_modes: technique presence treated as proof of falsehood
persuasion mislabeled where none exists
revisit_triggers: framing changes in a new version

nodes.definition: Analyze how the item spreads (virality pattern, amplification, super-spreaders) to gauge reach, urgency, and manipulation signals.
contradictors: platform that hides amplification mechanics

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when new diffusion data reveals coordinated or anomalous amplification

pros.claim: abnormal spread patterns flag likely manipulation
pros.example: a claim peaking via identical-timestamp reposts signals coordination

cons.claim: virality is not evidence of falsehood and data are often incomplete
cons.example: a true breaking story also spreads explosively

failure_modes: high reach mistaken for high credibility
organic and coordinated spread conflated

nodes.definition: Detect bots, troll farms, and coordinated inauthentic behavior amplifying the item using account, network, and behavioral signals.
contradictors: operator who makes fake accounts look organic

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when network or account evidence reclassifies authentic activity as coordinated or vice versa

pros.claim: coordinated networks expose disinformation operations behind a claim
pros.example: synchronized accounts pushing one hashtag reveal an influence operation

cons.claim: bot detection is noisy and real users get misclassified
cons.example: passionate real activists flagged as a bot network

failure_modes: activist surge mislabeled as a bot network
detector heuristics overfit to platform quirks
acceptance_tests: coordination claim supported by multiple independent network signals
false-positive risk on real users assessed

nodes.definition: Situate the item within echo-chamber and filter-bubble dynamics to understand why it resonates and how exposure is skewed.
contradictors: analyst who assumes uniform exposure across audiences

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when audience structure data revises the resonance/exposure picture

pros.claim: echo-chamber context explains persistence despite debunking
pros.example: a closed community keeps recirculating a refuted claim

cons.claim: echo-chamber effects are contested and easy to overstate
cons.example: cross-cutting exposure is often higher than the 'bubble' narrative implies

failure_modes: resonance mistaken for truth
echo-chamber strength overstated without data

nodes.definition: Detect affective manipulation (outrage, fear, identity triggers) engineered to bypass scrutiny and drive sharing.
contradictors: creator who masks manipulation as authentic emotion

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when reanalysis revises which affective triggers are engineered versus incidental

pros.claim: high-arousal framing is a robust correlate of viral falsehood
pros.example: an all-caps outrage headline is engineered to be shared before it is read

cons.claim: genuine high-stakes news is also emotional, so signal is not proof
cons.example: a real disaster report is legitimately alarming

failure_modes: emotional tone treated as proof of falsity
engineered and genuine affect conflated

nodes.definition: Screen the appraisal itself for confirmation bias, partisanship, and motivated reasoning that could distort the credibility judgment.
contradictors: appraiser who scores by prior belief not evidence

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when a bias check shows the verdict tracks the appraiser's prior rather than the evidence

pros.claim: an explicit bias screen catches motivated scoring before it locks
pros.example: an analyst is prompted to seek disconfirming evidence for a congenial claim

cons.claim: bias screens add steps and can themselves be performed superficially
cons.example: a checkbox 'I am unbiased' provides no real correction

failure_modes: disconfirming evidence under-weighted
verdict aligned to appraiser's politics

nodes.definition: Synthesize source, provenance, corroboration, claim-check, and manipulation findings into a composite, weighted credibility/confidence score.
contradictors: builder who hides a false-precision number with no rationale

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when a factor weight, scale, or upstream finding changes the composite score materially

pros.claim: a transparent weighted composite makes the score auditable
pros.example: each factor's contribution to the final number is itemized and reproducible

cons.claim: weighting is judgment-laden and a single number can hide disagreement
cons.example: averaging strong refutation with weak support yields a misleading 'mixed'

failure_modes: false precision presented without rationale
one factor silently dominates the composite
acceptance_tests: score reproduces from itemized factor contributions
weights and scale documented and justified

nodes.definition: Quantify residual uncertainty around the credibility score and calibrate stated confidence to evidence strength and base rates.
contradictors: scorer who states point verdicts with no uncertainty

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when calibration data or new evidence widens or narrows the confidence interval

pros.claim: calibrated uncertainty prevents over- and under-confident verdicts
pros.example: a 'likely false (60-75% confidence)' beats a bare 'false'

cons.claim: calibration without observed outcomes is itself heuristic
cons.example: stated intervals cannot be validated absent a track record

failure_modes: overconfident point verdict
uncertainty stated but not tied to evidence strength

nodes.definition: Assign the final verdict and rating-scale category with an explicit, traceable rationale linking score, uncertainty, and key evidence.
contradictors: editor who rounds a nuanced finding into a clickable label

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when a verdict is challenged, corrected, or contradicted by new evidence

pros.claim: a traceable rationale lets readers and reviewers audit the verdict
pros.example: each rating cites the score, uncertainty, and decisive evidence

cons.claim: a single rating label flattens nuance and can mislead
cons.example: labeling a partly-true claim simply 'false' is itself misleading

failure_modes: nuanced finding flattened into a misleading label
verdict stated without traceable rationale
acceptance_tests: verdict maps to score and stated uncertainty
rationale cites decisive evidence and is auditable

nodes.definition: Monitor the item after the verdict, issue corrections, and update the credibility score and beliefs as new evidence arrives.
contradictors: publisher who never revisits a published verdict

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: when new evidence, a correction, or a viral re-emergence warrants revisiting the verdict

pros.claim: timely correction limits the damage of a wrong or stale verdict
pros.example: reissuing a corrected rating when the underlying claim is updated

cons.claim: continuous monitoring is costly and corrections rarely reach the misled
cons.example: a correction gets a fraction of the original's reach

failure_modes: verdict left stale after new evidence
correction never propagated to original audience

edges.why_related: the scoped item and claim focus fix which claims to extract
edges.risk_of_conflict: extracting before scoping wastes effort
edges.example: scoping a clip to its central assertion before listing claims
edges.resolution_rule: settle scope and scale before extraction

edges.why_related: scope fixes the item whose disorder type is classified
edges.benefit_of_coupling: classification applies to the right artifact
edges.risk_of_conflict: classifying before scoping mislabels the wrong unit
edges.example: frame the post before judging mis vs disinformation
edges.resolution_rule: scope first, then classify disorder type

edges.why_related: scope identifies the content whose provenance is traced
edges.risk_of_conflict: tracing an unscoped item chases the wrong origin
edges.example: fixing which image to trace before searching its origin
edges.resolution_rule: scope the media item before provenance tracing

edges.why_related: scope identifies the source to appraise
edges.benefit_of_coupling: authority prior is set for the right publisher
edges.risk_of_conflict: appraising the wrong source wastes the prior
edges.example: fixing the publishing source before scoring its track record
edges.resolution_rule: scope the source before authority appraisal

edges.why_related: scope fixes the item whose spread is analyzed
edges.benefit_of_coupling: spread analysis targets the scoped item
edges.risk_of_conflict: analyzing spread of an unscoped item misattributes reach
edges.example: scoping the claim before measuring its virality
edges.resolution_rule: scope before spread analysis

edges.why_related: extracted claims are the units checked against authority
edges.risk_of_conflict: checking before extraction yields a strawman
edges.example: listing the numeric claim before querying the dataset
edges.resolution_rule: extract the claim before claim-checking it

edges.why_related: extracted claims define what corroboration must confirm
edges.risk_of_conflict: corroborating an unextracted claim is unfocused
edges.example: seeking independent sources for the specific quote
edges.resolution_rule: extract claims before corroboration

edges.why_related: the claim and its framing are the substrate for technique analysis
edges.benefit_of_coupling: techniques are mapped to actual claims
edges.risk_of_conflict: analyzing technique without the claim floats free
edges.example: spotting false dichotomy around the extracted claim
edges.resolution_rule: extract claim before technique inventory

edges.why_related: the claim's framing is scanned for affective triggers
edges.benefit_of_coupling: affect signals attach to the real claim
edges.risk_of_conflict: scanning affect without the claim misreads tone
edges.example: flagging outrage framing on the extracted claim
edges.resolution_rule: extract claim before affect screen

edges.why_related: provenance tracing initiates the reverse-image search for media origin
edges.benefit_of_coupling: reverse search extends the provenance trail
edges.risk_of_conflict: searching media before provenance scope misorders work
edges.example: tracing a photo's first appearance via reverse search
edges.resolution_rule: trace provenance before reverse-image matching

edges.why_related: recontextualization is ruled out before forensic synthesis detection
edges.benefit_of_coupling: forensics run only on plausibly synthetic media
edges.risk_of_conflict: running deepfake tools before recontext check wastes effort
edges.example: confirming a clip is not just old footage before forensic analysis
edges.resolution_rule: rule out recontextualization before synthesis forensics

edges.why_related: an unknown or weak authority prior triggers lateral reading
edges.risk_of_conflict: reading laterally without an authority question is aimless
edges.example: investigating who is behind an unknown outlet
edges.resolution_rule: set authority prior, then read laterally to resolve it

edges.why_related: source authority bounds how much weight a single source's claim carries
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring authority over- or under-weights sources
edges.example: down-weighting a low-track-record blog in the corroboration matrix
edges.resolution_rule: authority sets per-source weight in corroboration

edges.why_related: anomalous spread patterns trigger coordinated-behavior detection
edges.benefit_of_coupling: CIB detection focuses where spread is abnormal
edges.risk_of_conflict: running CIB detection without spread signals is unfocused
edges.example: investigating synchronized reposts flagged by spread analysis
edges.resolution_rule: analyze spread before CIB detection

edges.why_related: spread shape informs the echo-chamber/exposure analysis
edges.benefit_of_coupling: echo-chamber context builds on the spread profile
edges.risk_of_conflict: assessing chambers without spread data is speculative
edges.example: mapping which community recirculates the claim
edges.resolution_rule: profile spread before echo-chamber context

edges.why_related: triage escalations route claims into full claim-checking
edges.benefit_of_coupling: triage filters cheap clears from deep checks
edges.risk_of_conflict: over-trusting triage skips needed checks
edges.example: SIFT flags an item that then needs full verification
edges.resolution_rule: escalate to claim-check when triage cannot clear; stop when triage decisively clears or claim-check returns a verdict

edges.why_related: triage 'trace to original' can force a rescoping of the item
edges.benefit_of_coupling: early triage corrects a mis-scoped item
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring triage signals locks a wrong scope
edges.example: triage reveals the real claim sits in a linked source, prompting rescope
edges.resolution_rule: rescope when triage finds the true origin differs; stop after one rescope unless new origin emerges

edges.why_related: the source-authority prior is a weighted input to the composite score
edges.risk_of_conflict: scoring without authority omits a key prior
edges.example: feeding the outlet's track record into the composite
edges.resolution_rule: compute authority before composite scoring

edges.why_related: independence-adjusted corroboration is a major score input
edges.risk_of_conflict: scoring without corroboration overweights single sources
edges.example: weighting three independent confirmations into the score
edges.resolution_rule: corroborate before composite scoring

edges.why_related: per-claim accuracy findings are the core score input
edges.risk_of_conflict: scoring without claim-check ignores the substance
edges.example: feeding the dataset-confirmed accuracy into the score
edges.resolution_rule: claim-check before composite scoring

edges.why_related: manipulation likelihood for media is a score input
edges.risk_of_conflict: scoring media without forensics misses fabrication
edges.example: lowering a clip's credibility on confirmed synthesis
edges.resolution_rule: run media forensics before scoring media items

edges.why_related: presence of manipulation techniques adjusts the credibility prior downward
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring techniques overstates credibility
edges.example: discounting an item heavy with manufactured doubt
edges.resolution_rule: techniques inform but do not alone set the score

edges.why_related: coordinated amplification lowers the credibility prior for the claim
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring CIB overstates organic support
edges.example: discounting a claim pushed by a troll network
edges.resolution_rule: CIB findings adjust the prior, not the claim's truth

edges.why_related: engineered affect adjusts the manipulation-risk component of the score
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring affect misses bypass-of-scrutiny risk
edges.example: flagging an outrage-engineered item in the score
edges.resolution_rule: affect informs the manipulation component only

edges.why_related: the composite score is the basis for uncertainty quantification
edges.benefit_of_coupling: calibration wraps the right point estimate
edges.risk_of_conflict: calibrating without a score has nothing to bound
edges.example: attaching a confidence band to the composite
edges.resolution_rule: compute score before calibrating uncertainty

edges.why_related: the composite score drives the verdict and rating category
edges.risk_of_conflict: rating without a score is arbitrary
edges.example: mapping a 0.3 composite to 'mostly false'
edges.resolution_rule: score before verdict assignment

edges.why_related: calibrated uncertainty qualifies the verdict's confidence
edges.risk_of_conflict: rating without uncertainty overstates certainty
edges.example: stating 'likely false, moderate confidence'
edges.resolution_rule: calibrate before finalizing the verdict

edges.why_related: the bias screen constrains the score against motivated weighting
edges.risk_of_conflict: skipping the screen lets bias set the score
edges.example: forcing disconfirmation search before the score locks
edges.resolution_rule: bias screen must clear before score is final

edges.why_related: the bias screen constrains the final verdict against partisanship
edges.risk_of_conflict: skipping the screen risks a politicized rating
edges.example: blocking a verdict that tracks the appraiser's prior
edges.resolution_rule: verdict cannot finalize until bias screen passes

edges.why_related: the published verdict is the object that monitoring updates
edges.risk_of_conflict: monitoring without a verdict has nothing to update
edges.example: watching a published rating for new contradicting evidence
edges.resolution_rule: publish verdict before monitoring

edges.why_related: new evidence from monitoring triggers recomputation of the score
edges.risk_of_conflict: never updating leaves a stale score
edges.example: recomputing credibility when a primary record is revised
edges.resolution_rule: recompute when material new evidence arrives; stop when score change is below the materiality threshold

edges.why_related: monitoring can force reissuing or correcting the verdict
edges.benefit_of_coupling: verdict is corrected when wrong or stale
edges.risk_of_conflict: leaving a wrong verdict published spreads harm
edges.example: issuing a correction when the claim's status changes
edges.resolution_rule: reissue when the verdict is contradicted; stop after correction is published and propagated

edges.why_related: fast triage pressure conflicts with slow rigorous media forensics
edges.risk_of_conflict: skipping forensics for speed misses fabrications
edges.example: clearing a clip in triage that actually needs forensic analysis
edges.resolution_rule: for high-stakes or plausibly synthetic media, forensic rigor dominates triage speed

edges.why_related: high reach pressures scoring toward treating popularity as credibility
edges.risk_of_conflict: letting virality inflate the score conflates spread with accuracy
edges.example: a claim trending everywhere is scored credible despite no evidence
edges.resolution_rule: reach never raises the credibility score; it only sets urgency

edges.why_related: trust in source authority conflicts with claim-level diagnostic checking
edges.risk_of_conflict: over-trusting authority skips claim verification
edges.example: accepting a prestigious outlet's claim without checking the primary record
edges.resolution_rule: claim-level evidence dominates the authority prior when they disagree

edges.why_related: pressure for a decisive manipulation call conflicts with detector uncertainty
edges.benefit_of_coupling: keeps verdicts honest about detector limits
edges.risk_of_conflict: over-calling synthesis ignores detector error rates
edges.example: stating 'definitely fake' from a brittle detector
edges.resolution_rule: detector uncertainty must be carried into the score, not suppressed

edges.why_related: demand for a clean rating label conflicts with honest residual uncertainty
edges.risk_of_conflict: flattening uncertainty into a crisp label misleads
edges.example: forcing 'false' where evidence supports only 'likely false'
edges.resolution_rule: the rating must encode, not erase, calibrated uncertainty

edges.why_related: the disorder-type classification constrains the appropriate verdict framing
edges.risk_of_conflict: ignoring type yields a mismatched remedy
edges.example: framing malinformation differently from outright falsehood
edges.resolution_rule: disorder type shapes verdict framing, not truth value

conflict_axes.trigger: a fast verdict is demanded while the item is high-stakes or plausibly fabricated
resolution_order: apply triage to clear cheap cases
escalate stakes-weighted items to full verification
record what triage could not resolve
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: for high-stakes or plausibly synthetic items, rigor dominates speed
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: triage clears an item that stakes or forensic risk say must be checked
conflict_axes.example: an outrage clip is cleared in seconds but depicts a high-stakes fabricated event

conflict_axes.trigger: a claim's massive reach pressures the appraiser to treat popularity as credibility
resolution_order: measure reach for urgency only
score credibility solely on evidence
record reach separately from the score
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: reach sets urgency and never raises the credibility score
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a trending claim with no evidentiary support is treated as credible
conflict_axes.example: a hoax trending globally is mistaken for confirmed because everyone is sharing it

conflict_axes.trigger: a high-authority source makes a claim the primary record contradicts
resolution_order: use authority as a prior only
check the claim against primary records
let evidence override the prior when they disagree
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: claim-level diagnostic evidence dominates the authority prior
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a prestigious outlet's specific claim conflicts with the official dataset
conflict_axes.example: a respected paper misreports a statistic that the source data refutes

conflict_axes.trigger: intent is inferred from falseness alone without independent intent evidence
resolution_order: determine falseness from evidence
assess intent only from independent signals
default to misinformation when intent is unproven
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: falseness is decided by evidence; intent requires separate evidence and defaults to non-malicious when unknown
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a false claim is labeled deliberate disinformation with no evidence of intent
conflict_axes.example: a sincere viral error is branded a coordinated deception

conflict_axes.trigger: a decisive fake/real call is demanded from an uncertain detector
resolution_order: report detector output with its error profile
require corroborating provenance for a decisive call
carry residual uncertainty into the score
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: detector uncertainty is preserved; a decisive call requires independent corroboration
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a single brittle detector's output is stated as a definitive verdict
conflict_axes.example: 'definitely a deepfake' asserted from one over-tuned classifier

conflict_axes.trigger: a crisp shareable label is demanded while evidence supports only a qualified verdict
resolution_order: select the closest rating category
attach calibrated confidence to the label
record what would change the rating
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: the rating must encode calibrated uncertainty rather than erase it
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a partly-true claim is forced into a flat 'false' label
conflict_axes.example: rounding 'likely false, moderate confidence' to a bare 'false'

conflict_axes.trigger: appraisal volume pressures skipping the disconfirmation and bias screen
resolution_order: run the bias screen on every locking verdict
budget disconfirmation search by stakes
record skipped screens as a known risk
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: the bias screen must clear before a verdict locks, regardless of throughput pressure
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a high-volume desk skips disconfirmation search to hit a quota
conflict_axes.example: a congenial claim is rated true without seeking disconfirming evidence

conflict_axes.trigger: a verdict is closed and never revisited despite a changing evidence landscape
resolution_order: publish the verdict with a revisit trigger
monitor for material new evidence
reissue or correct when triggered
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: a published verdict stays open to correction; closure is provisional, not permanent
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a verdict is treated as final after a primary record is later corrected
conflict_axes.example: a debunk is never updated after the underlying claim is officially revised

edge_cases.trigger: multiple 'sources' all trace to one origin
edge_cases.failure_mode: echoed copies counted as independent corroboration
edge_cases.example: ten sites all reposting one wire story counted as ten confirmations
edge_cases.detection_method: trace each corroborating source to its origin and dedupe shared origins

edge_cases.trigger: authentic but recontextualized media is treated as synthetic
edge_cases.failure_mode: real media falsely flagged as a deepfake
edge_cases.example: an old real photo reshared with a false caption is called AI-generated
edge_cases.detection_method: run reverse-image recontext check before invoking synthesis detection

edge_cases.trigger: high reach is allowed to raise the credibility score
edge_cases.example: a trending hoax scored credible because of its reach
edge_cases.detection_method: verify reach contributes only to urgency, not to the credibility weight vector
resolution: zero reach's weight in the credibility score
re-derive score from evidence factors only

edge_cases.trigger: a brittle detector's output is stated as a definitive verdict
edge_cases.failure_mode: detector false positive presented as certainty
edge_cases.example: a re-compressed real video flagged 'fake' with high confidence by one tool
edge_cases.detection_method: require provenance corroboration and uncertainty carry-through for any decisive synthesis call
resolution: record detector version and error profile

edge_cases.trigger: intent to harm is inferred from falseness alone
edge_cases.example: a sincere error branded a coordinated deception without intent evidence
edge_cases.detection_method: check that any disinformation label cites independent intent evidence
resolution: downgrade to misinformation absent intent evidence

edge_cases.trigger: a precise composite number is published without uncertainty or rationale
edge_cases.example: a '0.41 credibility' shown with no interval and no factor breakdown
edge_cases.detection_method: verify every score ships with a calibrated interval and factor contributions

edge_cases.trigger: the verdict tracks the appraiser's prior rather than evidence
edge_cases.example: a congenial claim rated true without any disconfirmation search
edge_cases.detection_method: run an adversarial bias screen requiring documented disconfirmation search
resolution: re-derive verdict from evidence and re-screen

edge_cases.trigger: authentic activist activity is classified as a bot network
edge_cases.example: a passionate grassroots surge flagged as coordinated bots
edge_cases.detection_method: require multiple independent network signals and a false-positive risk assessment
resolution: record false-positive risk on real users

edge_cases.trigger: a published verdict is left stale after new evidence
edge_cases.example: a debunk never updated after the claim is officially revised
edge_cases.detection_method: compare published verdict timestamp against newest evidence and revisit triggers
resolution: propagate the correction to the original audience

edge_cases.trigger: an opinion or unstated implication is checked as if it were the claim
edge_cases.example: checking 'the economy is bad' instead of the implied checkable statistic
edge_cases.detection_method: verify each checked unit is a single falsifiable proposition from extraction
resolution: re-route the corrected claim to claim-check

edge_cases.trigger: a computed score field diverges from its formula after manual edits
edge_cases.example: final_importance edited by hand no longer matches the node formula
edge_cases.detection_method: recompute all derived fields from formulas and diff against stored values
resolution: rewrite metrics from the formula script

edge_cases.trigger: a template placeholder or unresolved field survives into output
edge_cases.example: an unfilled template token left in a pro/con example field
edge_cases.detection_method: scan serialized output for known placeholder tokens before acceptance
resolution: replace placeholder with a domain value

workflow.objective: scope the item, fix the credibility scale, and classify the information-disorder type
entry_criteria: an item and decision context are provided
acceptance_tests: item is a single scoped artifact
scale and threshold are explicit
workflow.do_first_because: every later score is relative to the framed scope and scale

workflow.objective: extract the specific falsifiable claims from the item
acceptance_tests: each claim is a single testable proposition
workflow.do_first_because: only explicit claims can be checked, corroborated, and scored

workflow.objective: trace content origin and run reverse-image/recontext checks on embedded media
acceptance_tests: first-seen and original context recorded
recontext check run on media
workflow.do_first_because: origin context often refutes the framing before any scoring

workflow.objective: appraise source authority via lateral reading and run SIFT triage
acceptance_tests: source investigated by leaving the page
triage decision recorded
workflow.do_first_because: the authority prior and cheap triage filter what needs deep checking

workflow.objective: run synthetic/manipulated-media forensics on plausibly fabricated media
entry_criteria: recontextualization ruled out for the media
acceptance_tests: manipulation claim corroborated by at least two independent signals
detector uncertainty recorded
workflow.do_first_because: media authenticity is high-risk and must be settled before scoring media

workflow.objective: corroborate independently, check claims against authority, and inventory manipulation signals
entry_criteria: claims extracted and source prior set
acceptance_tests: each claim mapped to an authoritative reference
corroboration deduped for independence
workflow.do_first_because: claim-level evidence is the substance the score is built on

workflow.objective: analyze spread, detect coordinated inauthentic amplification, and add echo-chamber context
acceptance_tests: coordination supported by multiple independent signals
false-positive risk assessed
workflow.do_first_because: amplification signals adjust the prior and flag urgency, kept separate from truth

workflow.objective: fuse findings into a composite credibility score, calibrate uncertainty, and run the bias screen
acceptance_tests: score reproduces from itemized factor contributions
bias screen documents disconfirmation search
workflow.do_first_because: the score must be debiased and reproducible before any verdict locks

workflow.objective: assign the final verdict and rating with a traceable, evidence-linked rationale
entry_criteria: score, uncertainty, and bias screen approved
acceptance_tests: verdict maps to score and stated uncertainty
rationale cites decisive evidence
workflow.do_first_because: the verdict is high-risk and irreversible once published, so it gates on full review

workflow.objective: monitor the published verdict and update the score, verdict, and beliefs as evidence arrives
acceptance_tests: new material evidence triggers recomputation
corrections propagated to the original audience
exit_criteria: monitoring window closed or verdict stable
workflow.do_first_because: a wrong or stale published verdict spreads harm until corrected

priority_rationale.notes: early type label shapes remedy and verdict framing
origin context often refutes early and cheaply
cheap moves filter most items before costly forensics
high-risk media authenticity gates media scoring
claim-level truth is the score's core
independent convergence is the strongest signal
affect engineering feeds the manipulation component
CIB findings adjust the prior with false-positive care
debiases the score before it locks
closes the loop and limits damage from staleness

dominance_rules.trigger: a faster verdict raises the chance of a wrong high-stakes judgment
dominance_rules.rule: rigor dominates speed for high-stakes or irreversible verdicts
dominance_rules.required_action: complete forensics and corroboration before verdict
dominance_rules.example: skipping media forensics to hit a deadline on a high-stakes clip

dominance_rules.trigger: a high-authority source's claim conflicts with the primary record
dominance_rules.rule: claim-level evidence dominates the source-authority prior
dominance_rules.required_action: check the claim against the primary record and let evidence decide
dominance_rules.example: a prestigious outlet's figure contradicted by the official dataset

dominance_rules.trigger: a viral claim pressures treating popularity as credibility
dominance_rules.rule: reach sets urgency only and never raises the credibility score
dominance_rules.required_action: keep reach out of the credibility weight vector
dominance_rules.example: a globally trending hoax scored credible because of its reach

dominance_rules.trigger: a valuable node is ready before its prerequisite is finalized
dominance_rules.rule: dependency order dominates raw value order
dominance_rules.example: scoring credibility before claims are extracted and checked

dominance_rules.trigger: a high-risk verdict, exclusion, or fabrication call is reached automatically
dominance_rules.rule: human review dominates automation for irreversible or high-risk decisions
dominance_rules.required_action: route to a human reviewer with a decision record
dominance_rules.example: publishing a 'fabricated' media verdict without human sign-off

dominance_rules.trigger: a confident number lacks eligible evidence support
dominance_rules.required_action: downgrade unsupported values to heuristic and cite the prior
dominance_rules.example: labeling a credibility weight 'observed' with no dataset

dominance_rules.trigger: a verdict is ready to lock before the bias screen and tests pass
dominance_rules.rule: QA and the bias screen dominate locking
dominance_rules.required_action: clear acceptance tests and the bias screen before any lock
dominance_rules.example: locking a verdict before disconfirmation search is documented

dominance_rules.trigger: a clean rating label is demanded while uncertainty is material
dominance_rules.rule: calibrated uncertainty dominates a tidy label
dominance_rules.required_action: encode the confidence band in the published rating
dominance_rules.example: forcing 'false' where evidence supports only 'likely false'

dominance_rules.trigger: an output asserts certainty beyond its source support
dominance_rules.required_action: tie every claim to an eligible source or qualify it
dominance_rules.example: stating intent as fact without independent intent evidence

dominance_rules.trigger: an object or verdict is created without a traceable evidence path
dominance_rules.required_action: attach evidence and rationale pointers before acceptance
dominance_rules.example: a rating published with no link to the decisive evidence

dominance_rules.trigger: a convenient sequencing would introduce a dependency cycle
dominance_rules.required_action: convert the weaker link to sequence or feedback
dominance_rules.example: making scoring depend on monitoring which depends on scoring

anti_rework_rules.rule: fix scope, scale, and claim focus before any checking or scoring
anti_rework_rules.rationale: checking against an unfixed scope forces a full redo
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: scores change after the item is rescoped
anti_rework_rules.example: scoring evidence before the item and scale are framed

anti_rework_rules.rule: extract explicit claims before corroboration and claim-checking
anti_rework_rules.rationale: verifying an unextracted claim checks a strawman
anti_rework_rules.example: corroborating 'the economy is bad' instead of a checkable statistic

anti_rework_rules.rule: trace provenance and rule out recontextualization before synthesis forensics
anti_rework_rules.rationale: running detectors on recontextualized real media wastes effort and over-calls
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: forensics flag synthesis on authentic old media
anti_rework_rules.example: deepfake-testing a real photo that was merely miscaptioned

anti_rework_rules.rule: complete verification and forensics before composite scoring
anti_rework_rules.rationale: scoring before evidence is in produces a number that must be redone
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: score recomputed after late evidence arrives
anti_rework_rules.example: publishing a composite score before the primary record is checked

anti_rework_rules.rule: run the bias screen before locking the score or verdict
anti_rework_rules.rationale: a biased score locked in forces a full reappraisal
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: verdict tracks the appraiser's prior on review
anti_rework_rules.example: locking a congenial verdict without disconfirmation search

anti_rework_rules.rule: calibrate uncertainty before assigning the final rating
anti_rework_rules.rationale: a verdict without uncertainty must be reissued when challenged
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: ratings restated after confidence is questioned
anti_rework_rules.example: publishing 'false' then walking it back to 'likely false'

anti_rework_rules.rule: populate all metric variables before computing derived scores
anti_rework_rules.rationale: computing scores from missing variables yields inconsistent fields
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: derived fields disagree with the formulas
anti_rework_rules.example: writing final_importance before its metric inputs exist

anti_rework_rules.rule: define nodes before edges that reference them
anti_rework_rules.rationale: edges to undefined nodes break reference integrity
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: edge endpoints reference missing node ids
anti_rework_rules.example: adding a corroboration edge before the corroboration node exists

anti_rework_rules.rule: settle dependencies before locking the priority order
anti_rework_rules.rationale: a priority order over unsettled deps must be redone
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: priority places a node before its prerequisite
anti_rework_rules.example: ranking scoring above claim-checking it depends on

anti_rework_rules.rule: build the verdict's traceability before publication
anti_rework_rules.rationale: an untraceable verdict cannot be defended or corrected efficiently
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: a published rating has no evidence linkage
anti_rework_rules.example: issuing a rating no reviewer can audit

iteration_protocol.trigger: a validator or review reports a failure
acceptance_tests: every failure mapped to a subsystem

iteration_protocol.trigger: multiple defects are open at once
iteration_protocol.detection: rank defects by risk and downstream impact
action: score defects by risk and coupling
acceptance_tests: highest-risk defects ordered first
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: queue empty or only sub-threshold defects remain

iteration_protocol.trigger: a defect touches scoring, dependencies, or the verdict
iteration_protocol.detection: trace affected nodes, edges, and scores
acceptance_tests: all affected objects identified

iteration_protocol.trigger: a defect is routed to its owning subsystem
acceptance_tests: each defect handled by its owner

iteration_protocol.trigger: base metrics, weights, or intervals changed
iteration_protocol.detection: re-run the formula script over all derived fields
action: recompute final_importance, risk, confidence, revisit, lock, posterior, edge fields
acceptance_tests: all derived fields match formulas within tolerance

iteration_protocol.detection: re-run the validator in dense mode
acceptance_tests: no hard failures remain

iteration_protocol.trigger: new evidence shifts a node's prior or confidence
acceptance_tests: posterior consistent with no-observed-data formula
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: posterior delta below the revisit threshold

iteration_protocol.trigger: a high-risk, irreversible, or low-confidence decision remains
acceptance_tests: reviewer decision recorded with rationale

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new KB version is produced
iteration_protocol.detection: compare counts and scores against the prior version
action: diff object counts and key scores
acceptance_tests: no unexplained regressions
residual defects documented and accepted
